draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 7.00, the 2nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 1st of 23 at DE. He went 3rd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 12 sacks in 2024, 4th of 23 DEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 17 career games and 6 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: qb hits 23 (92nd percentile), season snap share 75.6% (91st percentile), pressures 34 (91st percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 edge rusher who played: 4.0 sacks against a median of 1.0, above the norm.
